anya (Design): quick check — Create Pool validation patterns. inline errors by default; top summary only when >3 errors. required marker: explicit 'Required' (low-contrast) vs asterisk. delete flow: typed-confirm for prod-critical pools, checkbox+undo for others. feedback? kevin (Product): inline errors yes. summary helps on long forms. wording for summary should guide fixes. jamal (Eng): inline is easiest. keep error markup adjacent to inputs; avoid focus jumps on typing. linda (Design): asterisk confusing in testing. prefer visible 'Required' but low emphasis. show only on mandatory fields. chris (a11y): asterisk needs aria-required and hidden text for SRs. inline errors should use role="alert" and focus move to first error on submit. shawn (DevEx): small snippet we can reuse in SDK:
Name is required
marie (PM): for destructive copy: "Type the pool name to confirm deletion." add "This cannot be undone." typed-confirm for prod only; checkbox+30s undo for others. kevin (Product): agree. we should classify pools so UI shows correct pattern. anya (Design): SR concern — typed-confirm. thoughts? chris (a11y): typed-confirm fine with keyboard alternatives. make match case-insensitive, trim whitespace, provide aria-describedby linking to hint. jamal (Eng): implement case-insensitive trim; disable autocomplete on confirm input. server-side validation too. linda (Design): UI: compact input, inline match indicator, primary CTA disabled until match. microcopy placeholder: "enter pool name to confirm". shawn (DevEx): will add autocomplete off and SDK helper for typed-confirm block. marie (PM): proposed decisions: 1) inline errors default + top summary >3 errors; 2) visible 'Required' (low-contrast) + aria-required and sr-only; 3) typed-confirm for prod pools, checkbox+undo for others; 4) a11y checklist: role=alert, focus management, aria-describedby, autocomplete off. anya (Design): will update spec and Figma mocks. thumbs up if you agree. :thumbsup: ops-bot: preview for PR #4212: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/4212 kevin (Product): staging prototype + a11y sweep after. chris (a11y): will add SR test cases. :white_check_mark: anya (Design): thanks all — closing when PR merged.
